INSERT INTO asset_assignment (asset_assignment_id, company_id, asset_id, employee_id, it_ticket_id, issued_by, issued_at) VALUES (#{assignmentId}, #{companyId}, #{assetId}, #{employeeId}, #{ticketId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{actorAccountId}, CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP))
mapper.update: UPDATE asset_assignment SET returned_by = #{actorAccountId}, returned_at = CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP), updated_at = CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP) WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND asset_id = #{assetId} AND asset_assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND returned_at IS NULL

UPDATE asset SET status_code = #{targetStatus}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP) WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND asset_id = #{assetId} AND status_code = #{status} AND version = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT a.asset_id,a.asset_no,a.asset_name,a.asset_type,a.serial_no,a.branch_id FROM asset a WHERE a.company_id = #{companyId} AND a.asset_type = #{assetType} AND a.status_code = #{status} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM asset_assignment aa WHERE aa.company_id = a.company_id AND aa.asset_id = a.asset_id AND aa.returned_at IS NULL) ORDER BY a.asset_no,a.asset_id
